evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: ABSENT — No time-boxed framing or 'dependable quote' promise. Rep launches directly into accepting furniture list.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: ABSENT — Rep never asks 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' Customer raises concerns organically (cats, budget, wife/husband dynamics) but rep never solicits them systematically.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — No structured concerns elicitation, so no follow-up opportunity triggered.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — No summary reflection of customer concerns.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: FULL — Property type (two-story house), floor info (first floor only), rooms (confirmed no kids/bedrooms in use), walking distance (Burnett area, travel fee noted), special considerations (washer/dryer to garage, vintage sewing machine, fragile albums, antique cabinet, artwork). Extensive furniture inventory taken.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: FALSE — Rep never asked 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?' Customer brought it up, but rep did not proactively offer packing.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: TRUE — Rep provided typical anchor: 'usually we would see around 140 boxes for the house the size, but you guys are downsizing.' Customer estimated ~25–35 boxes.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: FULL — Rep anchored with hourly rate ($192/hour, two movers), travel fee ($75), and provided range: '8 to 9 and a half hours, $1,611 to $1,899' with personalization to their prep level ('the more prepared you are the more efficient') and focus on heavy pieces within budget.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: PARTIAL — Disclosed trip fee ($75) and 2.5-hour minimum ('the minimum that doesn't mean all our stuff gets moved'). Did NOT disclose overnight fee, packing materials, or explicit 15-minute-increment framing. Missing 'not a guess' commitment language.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: NOT ASKED — Rep never asked 'Does that feel fair?' No pause held for customer reaction to the quote.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: NONE — No Worries Damage Coverage never mentioned.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: FALSE — Rep did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' No loop-closing on the Two Promises.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: NOT ASKED — Rep never asked 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or equivalent. Call pivots directly to scheduling.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: FALSE — No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' question.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: FULL — Rep says 'And of course our next step is to put you on schedule' and 'So what do you think do' — implies booking, customer accepts, no easy-out offered.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: FULL — Date confirmed (October 6th), arrival window (8:30–9 AM), starting address (713 Wildwood, Georgetown), ending address (409 North Main, Burnett), and confirmation email promised. No explicit crew size or notes to crew about customer concerns recorded on call.

top_strength: Amy gathered an exhaustive, detailed furniture inventory (30+ items with dimensions, weights, special handling notes) and accurately quoted a rate-anchored estimate ($1,611–$1,899 for 8–9.5 hrs) personalized to the customer's budget constraints and prep strategy.
coaching_note: Amy skipped Section 2 (Their Agenda) entirely—never asked about concerns beyond price—and omitted all of Section 5 (the Two Promises: On-Time Guarantee and Damage Coverage), which are core trust-builders; add these structured asks before moving to booking.
booking_note: Customer explicitly confirmed move date: 'We're locked in for Tuesday, September. I sorry October 6th' with pickup address and time window confirmed by both parties.
